sentences.en: A lot of people are dealing with allergies now.
sentences.zh: 现在很多人正在经历过敏问题。

sentences.en: When you have food allergies, eating out is difficult, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 有食物过敏的话，外出就餐确实挺麻烦的吧？

sentences.en: Peanut allergy is the most common of food allergies.
sentences.zh: 花生过敏是食物过敏中最常见的。

senses.zh: (对食物、花粉、虫咬等的)过敏症
